title: Inside JetBrains—the company reshaping how the world writes code
description: JetBrains is integrating GPT-5 across its coding tools, helping millions of developers design, reason, and build software faster.
author: Desconocido

title: GPT-5 and the future of mathematical discovery
description: UCLA Professor Ernest Ryu and GPT-5 solved a key question in optimization theory, showcasing AI’s role in accelerating mathematical discovery.
author: Desconocido

title: Introducing shopping research in ChatGPT
description: Shopping research in ChatGPT helps you explore, compare, and discover products with personalized buyer’s guides that simplify decision-making
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI and Foxconn collaborate to strengthen U.S. manufacturing across the AI supply chain
description: OpenAI and Foxconn are collaborating to design and manufacture next-generation AI infrastructure hardware in the U.S. The partnership will develop multiple generations of data-center systems, strengthen U.S. supply chains, and build key components domestically to accelerate advanced AI infrastructure.
author: Desconocido

title: Helping 1,000 small businesses build with AI
description: OpenAI is partnering with DoorDash, SCORE, and local organizations to help 1,000 small businesses build with AI. The Small Business AI Jam gives Main Street business owners hands-on tools and training to compete and grow.
author: Desconocido

title: Early experiments in accelerating science with GPT-5
description: OpenAI introduces the first research cases showing how GPT-5 accelerates scientific progress across math, physics, biology, and computer science. Explore how AI and researchers collaborate to generate proofs, uncover new insights, and reshape the pace of discovery.
author: Desconocido

title: Strengthening our safety ecosystem with external testing
description: OpenAI works with independent experts to evaluate frontier AI systems. Third-party testing strengthens safety, validates safeguards, and increases transparency in how we assess model capabilities and risks.
author: Desconocido

title: How evals drive the next chapter in AI for businesses
description: Learn how evals help businesses define, measure, and improve AI performance—reducing risk, boosting productivity, and driving strategic advantage.
author: Desconocido
